entities.name: 1-Acetylnaphthalene
observations: The first SELFIES component decodes to CC(=O)c1cccc2ccccc12, an aryl methyl ketone.
It undergoes oxime formation with hydroxylamine-derived reagent under pyridine conditions.

entities.name: Hydroxylamine hydrochloride
observations: The [N][O] and [Cl] components are chemically interpreted as hydroxylamine hydrochloride, NH2OH·HCl, rather than a free nitrosyl species.

entities.name: Pyridine
observations: The heteroaromatic component decodes to c1ccncc1 and serves as base and/or solvent in the oxime-forming reaction.

entities.name: 1-Acetylnaphthalene oxime
observations: The plausible product is CC(=NO)c1cccc2ccccc12, also named 1-(naphthalen-1-yl)ethanone oxime.
E/Z oxime geometry may be unresolved from the input.
